direction.name: One motif
direction.idea: Take one shape from the subject and let it run the whole system. A drilling tool's octagonal cross-section becomes the buttons, the image masks and the loader. A two-account money app becomes two circles that recur as icon, inline dot and section colour. A café's striped awning becomes every band on the page. Look at the product, the logo, the object or the word in the headline and find the simplest geometry in it (a circle, an arc, a chamfer, a stripe, a notch, a ring). Then use only that shape, at three or four very different scales, everywhere a designer would normally reach for a generic rounded rectangle.
direction.composition: Hero: the motif appears once at enormous scale as a flat filled shape, cropped by the viewport (a circle 120vh across entering from the right, a chamfered block filling the lower half), with a short headline at 6–8vw and one supporting sentence set on the remaining ground, left-aligned on a shared margin. Through the page the motif returns as: the mask for every photograph (via `clip-path` or `border-radius` made from the same geometry), the shape of the primary button, the bullet beside list items at text size, and one full-width band that separates the two halves of the page. Sections use simple two-column or single-column layouts so the shape is the only thing with character.
direction.typography: A clean geometric or grotesk face that echoes the shape (round bowls for circles, squared terminals for chamfers). Medium weight; headings 6–8vw in the hero and 3–4vw after.
direction.colour: The motif carries the accent colour at large scale, flat. Everything else is ground and ink. A second motif colour is allowed only if the subject has a real pair (two accounts, two modes).
direction.imagery: Photographs appear inside the motif's shape. If there is product interface to show, it sits on a flat colour stage shaped by the motif. Draw the shape with CSS or a simple inline SVG path; do not draw illustrations.
direction.richness: One shape at many sizes. The giant cropped shape gives the hero mass and colour without a single image.
direction.pitfalls: One motif means one. A circle here, a hexagon there and a blob behind is the generated look this replaces. The motif must come from the subject and you must be able to say from where in one clause.

hero.name: Striped card beside the room
hero.blueprint: The viewport is split 50/50 with a 12px gap and 12px outer margins. The right half is one full-height photograph of the room, corners radiused 16px, `position: sticky` so it stays in view while the left half scrolls. The left half is a printed card: a flat paper-colour panel with the same 16px radius, and the subject's stripe (from its awning, label or ribbon) as the only ornament. Across the card's top runs a band 56px tall made of alternating bars of the single ink colour and paper, each bar 28px wide, built as a flex row of filled blocks. The same stripe returns as an 8px band above the footer and inside the button on hover. Under the band, centred: the wordmark about 300px wide, then a two-line headline in a light serif at clamp(40px, 3.6vw, 56px) in the ink colour, one supporting sentence at 17px held to 36ch, and the single action as a solid rectangular button. Three text links sit in one centred row at 15px, 28px above the card's bottom edge. One ink on paper; the photograph supplies every other colour.
hero.mobile: The photograph comes first at full width inside 12px margins, 48svh tall, with the 16px radius. The card follows and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge by 24px using a negative margin. Its striped band is 40px tall; below it the wordmark at 56% width, the headline at 8vw on two lines, the sentence and the button, all centred. The links wrap into the card's foot.
hero.headline: A warm two-line welcome of three to six words, up to about 18 characters per line at 3.6vw.

type.note: A compact bold geometric with a low waist, punchy in short lowercase lines, over a friendly open text sans. Suits newsletters, consumer products, creators and small shops.

palette.name: Swapping pastels
palette.note: One flat pastel is the whole background and it swaps per project or chapter: periwinkle, pink, sand, sage, peach. Type and one solid box stay near-black on all five, and dark teal is only for the button.

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Statement with inline thumbnails
sections.blueprint: A centred statement of 18–28 words, four lines at clamp(32px, 4.2vw, 62px), medium or bold weight, leading 1.12, in a block 60–66% of the viewport wide with 22vh of empty ground above and below. Three to five small frames sit inline between words: each is an `inline-block` 0.85em tall and 0.85–1.3em wide, `vertical-align: -0.1em`, radius 0.14em, holding a tightly cropped photograph (or a crop of real interface) of the thing the neighbouring word names. Frames are part of the line, never floating over it, with 0.12em of space either side. No heading above and no paragraph below; the statement is set as a `p`. Directly under the section the page may split into two flat colour halves or begin the first product row, so the thumbnails read as a preview of what follows. On a motif-driven page every frame takes the motif's shape.
sections.mobile: Left-aligned instead of centred, at 8vw with leading 1.15, about seven lines inside 20px margins. Keep at most three inline frames, each exactly one cap-height tall, and make sure none lands at the start of a line. Vertical padding drops to 96px.

sections.name: Two-column menu, photo bullets
sections.blueprint: A menu or catalogue list in which each item has a small cut-out photograph where a bullet would be. Each category opens with its name at clamp(32px, 3.4vw, 50px) at the left margin and the number of items at 16px right-aligned on the same baseline, with 96px above and 40px below. Items then run in two columns with a 64px gutter and 36px between rows. Each item is a two-part row: a 64px photograph of the item on a plain background at the left (multiplied onto the ground with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`, or masked to the page's one shape), then 20px to its right the name in bold at 17–18px with the price right-aligned on the same line, and beneath it a two- or three-line description at 15px in the soft ink, max 38ch. A short note such as an allergen follows the description in the accent ink. No boxes. Holds 6–10 items per category.
sections.mobile: One column. Photographs shrink to 52px and stay at the left; name and price share the first line with the description beneath at 15px. Category names at 8.5vw with the count on the same baseline. A sticky row of category names as text links lets the reader jump.

sections.name: One frame, contents change
sections.blueprint: Instead of many pictures side by side, one frame stays in place and its contents change. The frame is small and exact: 300px square on a quiet page, or up to 40vw at 4:5 on an object-led one, centred or sitting on the text column's left edge, with at least 20vh of empty ground above and below. Five to seven photographs are stacked inside it with `position: absolute` and crossfade in turn (opacity over 600ms, each held for 2.4 seconds, via CSS keyframes with staggered delays). All are shot or cropped alike: same scale, same light direction, the subject at the same position, so only the subject seems to change. On a flat ground use `mix-blend-mode: multiply` so studio backgrounds vanish. One caption line at 14px sits 16px below the frame and changes with the image. No arrows and no counter. On a motif-led page the frame takes the motif's shape through `clip-path`.
sections.mobile: The frame is 72vw wide, centred, in a section 70svh tall. The crossfade continues on its own; tapping the frame advances to the next image at once. The caption sits beneath, centred, at 14px. When reduced motion is requested the first image holds and tapping still advances.

sections.name: Clip-out coupon form
sections.blueprint: The form is a coupon to cut out. One filled card in a strong flat colour, about 2.2:1, spans columns 2–11 with a 14px radius, with 120px of ground above and below. Semicircular notches 28px across are cut into its top and bottom edges at the 46% mark with `clip-path` or an SVG `mask`, and a vertical row of round dots (a dotted `border-left` 5px thick in the ground colour) joins the two notches as the perforation. Left of the perforation, with 48px padding: a two-line heading of three to five words at clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px) in heavy capitals at the top, and one sentence at 16px at the bottom. Right of it: four inputs stacked with 10px gaps, each a filled block 52px tall in a lighter tone of the card with its placeholder at 16px, then a full-width solid submit bar 56px tall in the darkest ink. Inputs keep visually hidden `label` elements.
sections.mobile: The card turns upright and spans the width with 12px margins. The perforation becomes horizontal: notches on the left and right edges, dots across. Heading and sentence sit above it; the four inputs and the submit bar sit below, each 54px tall.

sections.name: The mark, built large
sections.blueprint: On a flat colour field, the brand closes the page as a construction rather than as set type. Across the full content width and about 34svh tall, the wordmark is built from blocks: each letter is knocked out of its own solid rectangle in a palette colour, the rectangles differ in height (60–100% of the band) and butt together with 4px gaps, bottoms on one line. Where the project has a simple geometric mark or motif, enlarge that instead, drawn as inline SVG from flat rectangles, circles and quarter-arcs with the same 4px gaps. Below, 56px lower: four columns of plain links at 15px across columns 1–8, and two addresses or contact lines in columns 9–12. A last row carries the copyright at the left and one small filled button at the right. Space and the block construction do all the separating.
sections.mobile: The block wordmark spans the full width at about 22svh tall; a long name breaks into two rows of blocks. Link columns go two across at 15px, contact lines beneath at full width, then copyright and the small button on one row.

references.name: Midnight
references.idea: The headline's circles are literally pictured: one blurred dark ring, sliced into horizontal bands, becomes the hero, the demo panel, the session cards and the footer.
references.hero: No navigation at all. A canvas fills the full width and the top 90% of the viewport: a huge out-of-focus dark navy ring on drifting taupe, sage and terracotta, cut into horizontal bands about 78px tall that are slightly offset like blinds. On the vertical centre line, starting 58px from the left, sit a small rounded-square line icon and a one-line headline at 48px in cream. On the same baseline, starting 59% across, a two-line 17px statement whose first sentence is white and bold while the rest drops to half opacity. The cream page background shows as a 90px strip at the bottom. No button.
references.type: Public Sans only, weight 500, tracking −0.04em. Headline 48px, mid-page statement about 38px on five centred lines, body 13–17px. Signature device: within one paragraph the first sentence is full strength and the remainder faded, replacing the usual heading-plus-subhead pair.
references.colour: #f4efe6 #07172a #867768 #687674 #a8735c #faf7f1 — Warm cream pages against midnight navy; the gradient mixes muted taupe, sage and terracotta around the dark ring. A peach-cream fills the small pill button. No bright accent anywhere.
references.imagery: An animated blurred ring gradient with band displacement and fine grain, used full-bleed in hero and footer, inset with 8px corners as the demo panel, and miniaturised onto three portrait session cards. No photos or UI screenshots.
references.layout: 30px side margins. Sections alternate between full-bleed gradient and cream type-only screens. Section headers split into left title and right small paragraph. Text blocks are short and often occupy one half of the width, leaving the other empty (the FAQ sits entirely in the right half).

sections.description: A full cream viewport with one centred paragraph of five lines at roughly 38px, about 820px wide. Only the opening sentence is dark; the remaining words are pale and darken progressively with scroll. Later, three small portrait cards, each about 115×180px with a mini gradient, a date at the top and a two-line label bottom-left, fan across the right side of the text, overlapping it with a soft shadow.

Header row: a two-line title at 34px on the left, a three-line 12px grey paragraph in the last fifth on the right. Below, a gradient panel spans the full content width, about 650px tall with 8px corners, holding a centred question at 34px in cream, a one-line caption, and an email capsule with an inline peach button; a small play capsule sits centred near its bottom edge.

A left-aligned two-line lead uses the dark-then-faded sentence device. Under it a two-by-two arrangement with no cards or borders, columns starting at 0 and 50%: each item is a 24px pale rounded-square icon, a quoted question as a 13px semibold title, then three or four lines of grey 12px text about 300px wide. A waitlist capsule floats fixed at bottom centre.

FAQ rows with hairlines and chevrons occupy only the right half of the screen above. The footer is the gradient again, full-bleed and about 190px tall: a two-line cream statement at left, an email capsule with inline button at right on the same line, and a row of tiny grey legal links along the bottom.

steal: Slice a soft blurred gradient into horizontal bands with small offsets so a familiar glow becomes a recognisable, ownable texture.
Replace heading-plus-subhead with one paragraph whose first sentence is full contrast and the rest half opacity.
Remove the nav from the hero entirely and put headline left and supporting line right on one shared baseline at mid-height.

references.name: SSTR - Friction Reduction
references.idea: Drilling hardware treated like precision consumer tech: a chamfered octagon taken from the tool's cross-section drives the buttons, icons and loader.
references.hero: The captured first viewport is the preloader: a 2 by 2 grid with hairline dividers, top-left quadrant solid orange with the slash-prefixed name at 5.6vw in black bold grotesk; top-right dark with a plus-sign dot grid and an orange square beside a percentage; bottom quadrants hold wireframe octagon stacks under small labels. The real hero is a full-bleed grey 3D render of a steel downhole tool rising from bottom centre. A two-line uppercase headline at about 3.5vw in light grotesk sits left-anchored at mid-height, with a short paragraph and an orange chamfered-corner button below. A slim bar holds logo left, five small caps links, globe and contact right.
references.type: ABC Monument Grotesk: bold for the loader mark, but headlines are regular or light uppercase with tight tracking at roughly 36 to 50px over 14px body. Uppercase labels at 10 to 11px carry a square orange bullet. Statistic numerals jump to about 6.7vw in a thin weight.
references.colour: #18191b #eff0f1 #ff5a2a #2f3032 #c3c4c8 — Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate; one safety orange marks buttons, bullets, the loader block and the highlighted chart series. Renders are desaturated steel so orange never competes.
references.imagery: Desaturated 3D renders of drilling tools, full-bleed in the hero and as a long drill string bending along a well path; thin wireframe octagon line drawings as service icons; a chart drawn in dots.
references.layout: Content sits inside vertical hairline rails about 35px in from each edge, with sections subdivided into two or three bordered cells. Dark and light sections alternate. Text blocks are left-aligned and narrow; a pinned well-path sequence breaks the grid with a full-bleed scene.

sections.description: Light grey section inside vertical hairline rails. An uppercase two-line heading at about 2.4vw sits top-left with an orange chamfered button under it. Below, three equal columns divided by hairlines, each about 230px tall: a wireframe line drawing of stacked octagons in the upper half, then an uppercase title at 13px and three lines of small grey body. No fills, no icon circles, no shadows.

Graphite section split into two bordered cells. Left cell, vertically centred: a tiny bracketed before-and-after range in caps, a statistic at about 6.7vw in thin grotesk, a one-word label and an orange chamfered button. Right cell: a line chart drawn entirely in dots, white for the baseline and orange for the improved run, with faint axis labels and a two-item legend using short colour bars.

Pinned full-viewport dark scene. A 3D drill string enters at top-left, runs down, bends through ninety degrees and continues along the bottom to the right edge, with bright tool segments spaced along it. A text block right of centre holds a small orange-bulleted label, a four-line uppercase statement at about 2vw and two lines of body. Bottom edge: a back-to-start link left, a chevron scroll cue centre, a skip link right.

steal: Derive one shape from the product (here a chamfered octagon) and reuse it for button corners, icons and loader graphics.
Draw charts with dots rather than lines and reserve the accent colour for the one data series you want read.
Turn the preloader into a branded four-cell grid that previews the site's colour blocks and wireframe icons.
references.media: A full-bleed 13s monochrome loop of a drilling tool descending over grey sand covers the whole fold with the text straight on it at the left, oversized for parallax. Below: a full-bleed WebGL chapter with the caption right of centre and a depth gauge at the edge, line-drawn icons in three equal cells, dot-plot charts beside big figures zigzagging per row, a 4:1 product strip under a giant product-code heading, and 3:2 case photographs in a right-hand column; 33 images and 3 videos, 0px radius.
references.motion: On desktop the video plays from 400ms while every text line shows as a solid orange bar the size of the line, like redaction, and the type replaces the bars by 1.2s. Under Lenis the hero video parallaxes at scrub 2, heads rise as masked lines over 0.6-0.82s expo.out at a 0.04-0.06 stagger, chart dots switch on one by one (1004 rects at 0.15s), stats roll digit columns, the WebGL chapter is step-locked with skip controls, and buttons fill with a clip-path sweep over 0.375s; there are 10 reduced-motion rules.

references.name: Madie
references.idea: A burgundy-and-cream bakery brand in which the madeleines themselves, cut out like specimens, become the menu.
references.hero: A dark, warm photograph (iced coffee with a logo sticker and a glazed madeleine on a wooden counter, burgundy tiles behind) fills a rounded-corner frame inset 20px from every edge on a cream page; the subject sits right of centre. In the left column, starting 42% down: a small star-rating line, then a three-line uppercase headline at 5vw in a heavy geometric sans, the first two lines outline-only and the third solid cream, a three-line paragraph, and a row with a pink pill button and an underlined text link. Top-left: menu icon and script logo. Top-right: a three-language pill toggle. Bottom-right: a circular text badge.
references.type: Dazzle, a heavy geometric uppercase, for headlines at 72px, used both solid and as an outline stroke; Cottorway, a slightly wide geometric sans, for 14px body and for a light italic accent word. A brush-script logo. Tracked capitals near 10px for labels.
references.colour: #f6efe6 #3d0012 #5c0a23 #ff99d3 #160b0a #e8a530 — Cream and deep burgundy alternate by section across wavy boundaries. Bubblegum pink is reserved for buttons, the active filter pill and carousel arrows; the product cut-outs supply every other colour.
references.imagery: A moody warm-graded hero photo; individual madeleines shot from above and cut out with soft shadows as small menu thumbnails; white line drawings (dog in beret, cafe table); rounded photo cards stacked at a tilt; a map redrawn in burgundy.
references.layout: Centred intro, a left-anchored story block on burgundy, then a two-column menu inside a container about 60% of the width. Section edges are curved waves rather than straight lines. Rounded frames and a sticky header with filter pills recur throughout.

sections.description: Cream field, everything centred. A tiny tracked-capitals label flanked by two short rules, then a two-line heading: the first line outlined uppercase in burgundy at about 4.5vw, the second a lowercase light italic of the body sans, solid. Three short paragraphs at 13px follow in a column about 45% wide. The section ends in a burgundy wave rising from the bottom, with a white line-drawn dog perched on the curve.

Burgundy field patterned with a faint tone-on-tone repeat of the logo. Left: a white line illustration, a three-line paragraph with bold phrases, two round pink arrow buttons and a slide counter. Right: a stack of portrait photo cards with rounded corners, the top one tilted a few degrees and the others fanned behind it. The bottom edge curves back to cream.

A sticky row of three pill filters beside the logo, the active one filled pink. Each category has an outlined uppercase label at left, an item count at far right and a hairline beneath. Items run in two columns: a 60px cut-out madeleine at left, then a bold uppercase name and a two-to-three-line italic description; some carry a tiny best-seller note or a pink allergen tag. No prices and no boxes.

Deep burgundy. The left two-thirds is an interactive map restyled entirely in burgundy and pink with rounded corners, the script logo as its pin and a small address card overlaid bottom-left. The right third is a rounded outlined panel listing opening hours, phone and email under tiny capital labels, plus two social icons. The script logo, large and white, is centred below, followed by a tracked-capitals legal line.

steal: Set a headline with its first lines as outline strokes and the last line solid, so emphasis falls on the final phrase without a size change.
Replace the stock map with one restyled in the brand's two colours and use the logo as the pin.
Build the menu from small cut-out product photos beside bold names and italic notes in two columns, with no cards.
